Objective: Help children connect the Alphabet Garden to the idea of food origin through safe observation, matching, sorting, drawing and talk.
Materials: Picture cards, clean produce examples where approved, baskets/trays, crayons, labels, handwashing supplies.
DIY: Use locally available baskets, clean reused food-grade containers, handmade labels, paper process cards and simple balances/measuring vessels where suitable.
Steps: 1. Show a garden or food example. 2. Name where it comes from. 3. Let children match, count, sort or draw. 4. Demonstrate clean hands and gentle handling. 5. Ask children to tell one step from garden to food.
Evidence: Correct match, simple count/sort, drawing or oral explanation.
Challenge: Can the learner show what happens before and after the selected step?
Safety: No tasting unless the school has separately approved a supervised food activity. Wash hands before and after handling produce. Use only clean, teacher-approved samples and containers. Teachers control knives, heat, electrical equipment, chemicals and any processing machinery.
